column1: # Hand-written glosses for the roots no dictionary in the pipeline covers.
# Phase 24 Task 8 killed the last automated candidate: Salmone reached 12 of
# these 14 roots and got 7 flat wrong ("Pocketed." for همن, "Small-eared." for
# صمع), because its leading sense is taken with no corpus form behind it. So
# these are written by hand, one per root, from the corpus's own per-word
# English glosses (word_glosses) plus whatever perseus-lane already carries --
# i.e. from the senses the Quran actually uses, not from a dictionary's first
# Format is import-lane's: root_buckwalter<TAB>definition. The header line above
# binds the file to `--source editorial` (scraper/source_header.py); importing
# it under any other tag raises.
# import-lane only upserts. Editing a row here and re-importing rewrites it;
# DELETING a row here does not delete anything live -- that needs

column2: how?; in what manner, in what state
group, party, band; company of troops
forelock, the lock of hair over the forehead
to hasten with the gaze fixed ahead; to race forward
scum, refuse; dry stubble swept along by a torrent
to crush, to break into fragments; dry crumbled stalks
to watch over, to guard; guardian, protector
to deafen with a piercing noise; deafening blast
to give short measure; to defraud in weighing
